title: Tamil Nadu Government Employees New Health Insurance Scheme Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Health insurance programme for eligible Tamil Nadu government employees and their covered family members.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Serving Tamil Nadu government employees and eligible family members under current NHIS rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Tamil Nadu Government Employees New Health Insurance Scheme.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
